_comment: Editable scenario assumptions. Measured pilot numbers live in pilot_calls.jsonl / pilot_runs.json and are never edited here.

fallback_model._comment: fallback uses the same Claude backend/prompt as verification; if the pilot had no fallback calls, its per-text cost is taken from the measured verify cost per review

local_compute._comment: Local CPU work (ingest, SQL, export) on the student's laptop. Unknown values stay null and are reported as unknown, not zero.
